top_signals.title: BlackRock Pushing For New 'ETIF' Hybrid
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Vildana Hajric joins Isabelle Lee and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." BlackRock is pushing to redraw the boundaries of the $16 trillion US exchange-traded funds industry with a novel investment vehicle that would marry two of Wall Street’s biggest obsessions: the trading ease of ETFs and the allure of private markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
